items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: this portrait was copied off of a photo that the wife of the trombone player -- Herb Gardner's wife was out of New City

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yes, Volume No. 2, the picture on No. 2 is the way I look now with my gray hair and the Navajo shirt, the Navajo necklace and this portrait was copied off of a photo that the wife of the trombone player -- Herb Gardner's wife was out of New City -- who was a trombone player.
I see. New City is not far from here?
